reference_runner_smoke_test.note: Known-status Brier diagnostic only; not comparable to historical IPCW Brier.

known_gaps: historical experiment-specific training scripts and exact parameters were not present in archived historical result packages
this package is a transparent reference reimplementation and must not be represented as an exact reproduction of historical v1/v2/v3 experiments
only three simulator seeds are currently available
bootstrap analysis uses 200 replicates and fixed predictions; model-refitting uncertainty is not captured
independent sigmoid/isotonic cause-specific calibration can violate joint CIF probability coherence; not deployment-ready
no real CRM validation; findings are limited to the synthetic simulator environment
revenue forecasting has not yet received a dedicated validated benchmark

ipcw_validation.metric: cause-specific IPCW Brier with training/dev censoring Kaplan-Meier
ipcw_validation.important_limit: reference implementation; not exact historical v2 reproduction

stage_a2_4.calibration: IPCW-weighted logistic calibration intercept and slope
limitations: fixed-model predictions; no refit within bootstrap
company bootstrap has only 18 held-out companies per seed
cross-seed average interval endpoints are not pooled CIs

stage_a2_5.calibration_split: 20% account-group holdout from train/dev, per seed and landmark
limitations: calibration subset is not company-level holdout
independent cause calibrators can violate CIF simplex
no bootstrap intervals for calibration deltas
